excerpts.content:
Reposting here from <#892088344438255616> for visibility

> Both EIP-6110 & 7002 extend the block body. Which of the new fields comes first?

I think most agree we should first add 6110 header field (deposits) and then 7002 header field (withdrawal reqs). Same for block bodies.
